baseline_models.focus_anchor: لعب ولهو وزينة وتفاخر بينكم وتكاثر في الأموال والأولاد
baseline_models.mechanism: The nouns form an escalation from purposeless activity and diverted attention to display, reciprocal status claims, and numerical rivalry; wealth and children become the scorekeeping medium.

activation_trace.role: Purposeless joking action supplies the low-stakes activity that begins the escalation.
Being occupied away from something turns play into diversion from a competing end.
Counting merits and mutual vaunting makes ornament publicly comparative.
Trying to prevail by number converts possessions and offspring into a social scoreboard.

changed_reading.before: The opening is a loose list of worldly pleasures.
changed_reading.after: It is an ordered social mechanism in which diversion matures into display and competitive counting.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أعجب الكفار نباته ثم يهيج فتراه مصفرا ثم يكون حطاما
baseline_models.mechanism: Attraction fixes judgment on the crop's visible rise, while the repeated temporal steps expose drying and fragmentation as equally real phases of the same production cycle.

activation_trace.role: Beauty in the eye makes favorable perception the entry point of the mistake.
Growth emerging from earth supplies the admired productive phase.
Plant-yellowing and desiccation turns peak growth toward exhaustion.
Dry matter broken into fragments completes the cycle as loss of coherent form.

changed_reading.before: The crop is a generic image of transience.
changed_reading.after: The crop diagnoses selective seeing: admiration treats one visible phase as the whole while the same process is already moving toward fragmentation.

baseline_models.mechanism: The near life offers real usable benefit, but its proximity and bright promise invite it to be priced as final; deception lies in the valuation, not in denying every utility.

activation_trace.role: Nearness makes the present life cognitively and affectively immediate.
A useful provision for needs preserves genuine but limited instrumental value.
A glitter that fails to hold turns limited utility into a false promise of durable worth.

changed_reading.after: Its benefit can be real while its nearness and unstable glitter make it a deceptive final measure of value.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding economy opposes self-multiplication by counting with entrusted circulation: holdings pass through successors, money exits in spending, and a cut-out loan returns multiplied. The problem in تكاثر is possessive rivalry, not increase as such.

activation_trace.role: Numerical rivalry anchors the focus ayah's closed, comparative mode of increase.
Money going out in expenditure supplies an outward flow opposed to stockpiling.
One holder succeeding another makes possession delegated and temporary.
A portion cut from wealth for recompense models relinquishment rather than display.
Increase by another like amount relocates multiplication from the owner's count to returned reward.

structural_cues: 57:7 introduces delegated holding before the repeated spend-loan-multiply sequence of 57:10-11 and 57:18.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, outflow, loan, and multiplied return; I infer that this open circuit corrects the closed circuit of تكاثر. A live alternative is that these are independent spending commands rather than a revision of the focus's economics.

changed_reading.before: The ayah condemns having or increasing wealth.
changed_reading.after: It condemns treating temporary holdings as a private ranking total; outward transfer can itself become a legitimate, divinely returned increase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby declaration that earth is enlivened after death prevents the focus crop from becoming a one-way ontology of decay. Its collapse is real, but it is one phase under a power that can restart earth-life.

activation_trace.role: Earth-life through rain and vegetation lets both mentions of life resonate with the crop process.
Dry fragmentation anchors the apparent terminal phase that context revises.
Earth enlivened by rain and vegetation supplies a restart after barrenness.
Dead earth or lifeless material makes the restart explicitly cross the apparent endpoint.

structural_cues: 57:17 places earth-life-after-death only three ayat before the rain-growth-yellowing-fragment sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dead earth made alive and the focus supplies crop disintegration; I infer that context reopens the focus's terminal-looking process. Alternatively, 57:17 may prove resurrection without modifying the crop analogy's local endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The crop establishes an irreversible line from growth to ruin.
changed_reading.after: The ruin warns against absolutizing a visible phase; earth's life can be restarted after the very state that looked terminal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The imperative to race immediately redirects the focus's competitive energy: rivalry in quantity is replaced by forward movement toward protective forgiveness and a gift whose excess is not self-produced.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing by number supplies the mis-aimed competitive motion.
Advancing in a race preserves competition while changing its destination.
Covering fault and shielding its bearer gives the race a restorative goal.
Gifted beneficence makes the sought surplus received grace rather than a superiority count.

structural_cues: سابقوا opens 57:21 directly after the focus's تكاثر and points toward forgiveness and garden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies numerical rivalry followed immediately by racing toward forgiveness and gift; I infer deliberate redirection of competitive drive. The alternative is a new exhortation with no corrective relation to تكاثر.

changed_reading.before: The focus rejects competitive striving itself.
changed_reading.after: It rejects the scoreboard and destination, while the next ayah retains urgency and rivalry in a race toward forgiveness and bestowed excess.

context_deltas.mechanism: What escapes and what is given produce the loss and gain poles of attachment; gain swells into exultation, strutting, and boasting, while fear of loss closes into withholding. This supplies the affective engine behind display and accumulation.

activation_trace.role: Unstable glitter anchors the deceptive valuation that recruits emotion.
The image of something being given destabilizes the possessor's claim of self-originated ownership.
Failure to reach or retain something supplies the loss pole of attachment.
Exultant, insolent joy supplies the inflated response to acquisition.
Conceited gait externalizes acquisition as bodily status display.
The focus branch of counting merits and boasting recurs explicitly, confirming the status link.
Miserliness turns attachment into blocked circulation and recruits others into the same closure.

structural_cues: 57:22-24 moves from prior inscription through missed/given affect to conceit, boasting, and commanded miserliness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence missed, given, exulted, strutted, boasted, withheld; I infer a causal ownership loop behind the focus list. A live alternative is a cluster of adjacent moral prohibitions without a single psychological arrow.

changed_reading.before: Boasting and accumulation are visible social faults.
changed_reading.after: They are outputs of an attachment loop that misreads gifts as possessions, oscillates with gain and loss, and finally blocks their outward movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Balance, equity, iron, and benefits establish a positive material counter-model: matter and measurement are retained when ordered to justice and public use. The focus attacks deceptive valuation, not material capacity itself.

activation_trace.role: Useful provision anchors the focus's admission that worldly goods can serve needs.
A balance of justice replaces competitive quantity with accountable measure.
Equity supplies the social end by which measurement is judged.
Iron's resistant solidity preserves strong material agency rather than rejecting it.
Benefit opposed to harm assigns material strength a public-use function.

structural_cues: 57:25 coordinates book, balance, justice, iron, force, and benefits in one institutional sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies just measure and useful strong matter; I infer an evaluative contrast with wealth as display and deceptive provision. Alternatively, 57:25 may begin an institutional theme independent of the focus's valuation critique.

changed_reading.before: The focus invites rejection of material goods and quantitative measure.
changed_reading.after: It distinguishes deceptive status metrics from just measurement and useful material strength; the latter remain positively deployable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it spatializes a temporal crop parable. It remains anchored in the focus's glittering deception and in 57:13's literal wall, inside, and outside; render it only as an exploratory surface/reality analogy, not as a claim that the focus secretly denotes that wall.

activation_trace.role: A glittering promise that does not hold anchors the focus's misleading visible face.
A high enclosing wall supplies the concrete partition on which opposed readings can coexist.
The inside of a thing supplies a concealed valuation distinct from its face.
The back or exterior opposed to the interior supplies the exposed side of the reversal.

changed_reading.before: The crop image contrasts an attractive present with a later collapse only in time.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the attractive world also behaves like an exterior face of a partition: visible valuation and inward outcome can occupy opposite sides at once.

strongest_changes: تكاثر is revised from increase itself to a closed ownership scoreboard, contrasted with entrusted outflow and multiplied return.
The crop's apparent terminal decay is reopened by nearby earth-life after death.
Competition is redirected rather than erased: سابقوا replaces numerical rivalry with a race toward forgiveness and bestowed grace.
Gain, loss, exultation, conceit, boasting, and withholding expose an affective ownership loop behind the focus list.
Balance, justice, iron, and benefit preserve a positive role for measured material capacity.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly reuses the focus's own pressure points while reversing their direction: multiplication becomes outgoing loan-return, crop death becomes revivable earth, rivalry becomes racing, and material measure becomes justice rather than status.
remaining_uncertainties: The circulation model may coordinate adjacent commands more tightly than the text requires.
The wall-based inside/outside reading is a contained analogy, not a lexical sense of the focus ayah.
The positive material counter-model in 57:25 may be structurally adjacent without directly revising 57:20.
